description: A MiniMax model for practical productivity, coding, and real-world digital work. Training across varied digital work environments extends its coding foundation into practical, end-to-end productivity tasks.

i18n.en: A MiniMax model for practical productivity, coding, and real-world digital work. Training across varied digital work environments extends its coding foundation into practical, end-to-end productivity tasks.
i18n.zh: 面向实际生产力、编程与真实数字化工作的 MiniMax 模型。通过多样化数字工作环境训练，将编程基础能力扩展到实用的端到端生产力任务。

description: An agentic MiniMax model for autonomous productivity and multi-agent collaboration. It emphasizes autonomous productivity, multi-agent collaboration, and continuous improvement in real-world work.

i18n.en: An agentic MiniMax model for autonomous productivity and multi-agent collaboration. It emphasizes autonomous productivity, multi-agent collaboration, and continuous improvement in real-world work.
i18n.zh: 面向自主生产力与多 Agent 协作的 Agent 型 MiniMax 模型。强调真实工作场景中的自主生产力、多 Agent 协作和持续改进。

description: A high-speed variant of MiniMax M2.7 for faster inference at the same capability level. Optimized for latency-sensitive productivity and agent workflows.

i18n.en: A high-speed variant of MiniMax M2.7 for faster inference at the same capability level. Optimized for latency-sensitive productivity and agent workflows.
i18n.zh: MiniMax M2.7 高速版，相同能力下推理速度更快。针对延迟敏感的生产力任务与 Agent 工作流优化。

description: A long-context multimodal MiniMax model for coding, knowledge work, and agents. The multimodal foundation is designed for long-horizon agents, coding, and knowledge work over extended context.

i18n.en: A long-context multimodal MiniMax model for coding, knowledge work, and agents. The multimodal foundation is designed for long-horizon agents, coding, and knowledge work over extended context.
i18n.zh: 适合编程、知识工作与 Agent 的长上下文 MiniMax 多模态模型。多模态基础能力面向长周期 Agent、编程和长上下文知识工作。

description: MiniMax file speech recognition (asr-1.0) via POST /v1/speech_to_text. Set the route provider model name to asr-1.0 and the adapter to minimax-asr-file. Billed per second of upstream duration, with no minimum.

i18n.en: MiniMax file speech recognition (asr-1.0) via POST /v1/speech_to_text. Set the route provider model name to asr-1.0 and the adapter to minimax-asr-file. Billed per second of upstream duration, with no minimum.
i18n.zh: MiniMax 文件语音识别（asr-1.0），走 POST /v1/speech_to_text。路由的供应商模型名填 asr-1.0，适配器选 MiniMax 文件转写。按上游时长按秒计费，没有最低时长。

description: MiniMax sync speech synthesis (speech-2.8-hd) via POST /v1/t2a_v2. Set the route provider model name to speech-2.8-hd and the adapter to MiniMax audio.speech passthrough. Billed per upstream usage_characters.

i18n.en: MiniMax sync speech synthesis (speech-2.8-hd) via POST /v1/t2a_v2. Set the route provider model name to speech-2.8-hd and the adapter to MiniMax audio.speech passthrough. Billed per upstream usage_characters.
i18n.zh: MiniMax 同步语音合成（speech-2.8-hd），走 POST /v1/t2a_v2。路由的供应商模型名填 speech-2.8-hd，适配器选 MiniMax audio.speech 透传。按上游 usage_characters 计费。

description: MiniMax low-latency sync speech synthesis (speech-2.8-turbo) via POST /v1/t2a_v2. Set the route provider model name to speech-2.8-turbo and the adapter to MiniMax audio.speech passthrough. Billed per upstream usage_characters.

i18n.en: MiniMax low-latency sync speech synthesis (speech-2.8-turbo) via POST /v1/t2a_v2. Set the route provider model name to speech-2.8-turbo and the adapter to MiniMax audio.speech passthrough. Billed per upstream usage_characters.
i18n.zh: MiniMax 低延迟同步语音合成（speech-2.8-turbo），走 POST /v1/t2a_v2。路由的供应商模型名填 speech-2.8-turbo，适配器选 MiniMax audio.speech 透传。按上游 usage_characters 计费。

description: MiniMax text-to-image and subject-reference image generation (image-01) via POST /v1/image_generation. Set the route provider model name to image-01 and the adapter to MiniMax images.generations passthrough. Billed per successful image.

i18n.en: MiniMax text-to-image and subject-reference image generation (image-01) via POST /v1/image_generation. Set the route provider model name to image-01 and the adapter to MiniMax images.generations passthrough. Billed per successful image.
i18n.zh: MiniMax 文生图与主体参考图生图（image-01），走 POST /v1/image_generation。路由的供应商模型名填 image-01，适配器选 MiniMax images.generations 透传。按成功张数计费。

description: MiniMax image-01-live generation via POST /v1/image_generation, including the live style. Set the route provider model name to image-01-live and the adapter to MiniMax images.generations passthrough. Billed per successful image.

i18n.en: MiniMax image-01-live generation via POST /v1/image_generation, including the live style. Set the route provider model name to image-01-live and the adapter to MiniMax images.generations passthrough. Billed per successful image.
i18n.zh: MiniMax image-01-live 生图，走 POST /v1/image_generation，支持 live 风格。路由的供应商模型名填 image-01-live，适配器选 MiniMax images.generations 透传。按成功张数计费。
